league_wrap.title: Camp Desk — Tuesday, Sep 8
league_wrap.bottom_line: Five news clubs only after Monday’s full-32: ATL names Tua Week 1 QB1 (Penix inactive); NYG cuts Slayton; NE/SEA Monday IR (Brown OUT, Henderson still DNP, Okada still DNP); TEN Gray into concussion protocol. All Pass — no new win-totals, no minted KEI.
storylines: Falcons: Club named Tua Tagovailoa Week 1 starter at PIT (Sep 7 AM). Stefanski: Cooper Rush backs him up; Michael Penix Jr. inactive. Closes the open QB1 that Monday’s card still had as Penix vs Tua. Pass — QB identity, not a half-win lean.

Giants: Released WR Darius Slayton Monday evening (longest-tenured Giant). OBJ / Mooney / Nabers / Fields depth already on the Sep 7 53 note — this is the cut that finishes the WR room. Pass — do not invent WR1a.

Patriots @ Seahawks (Wed): Monday IR — NE OL Ben Brown OUT (knee, did not travel); RB TreVeyon Henderson DNP ankle again; DT Christian Barmore FULL after Sunday DNP. SEA S Ty Okada still DNP hamstring; Emmanwori limited (ankle, more work Mon); Bradford upgraded FULL. Pass — availability flags only.

Titans: LB Cedric Gray in concussion protocol after weekend UTV accident (club statement Sep 7 PM). Week 1 vs NYJ availability in doubt until protocol clear. Pass — LB availability flag; do not invent a replacement starter.
league_wrap.what_to_watch: Wed night SEA/NE final designations (Henderson / Okada / Emmanwori). Thu Melbourne LAR/SF. Gray protocol progress before Sunday TEN vs NYJ. No chase on LAC Under 2/5 or DEN Over 2/5.
